displayName: Nordstrom Product Data API - Search, Reviews, SKU Stock, Store Pickup
description: Nordstrom product data as structured JSON - search nordstrom.com, browse any category, sale section or brand page with filter counts, read one product with every size and color as a SKU with UPC, price, price type (regular, clearance, promotion), stock and units available to ship plus the star histogram, size-fit distribution and the reviews shown on the page, pull a product's review history (up to 200 per call) sorted and filtered by stars, verified purchase, photos or text with the rating summary, size and width fit, praised and criticized features and the AI review summary, check per-SKU ship and store-pickup availability with the stores that can do pickup, find Nordstrom stores near a ZIP with hours and services, and pull search autocomplete. 8 endpoints, 5 credits each, availability and reviews 10.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
